author: claude-opus-5-5
visual_review: Inspected 48px and 384px in light and dark: three swept blades, each bulging on its leading edge with a rounded tip, turned 120 degrees apart around a round hub, so the propeller keeps its rotational direction. A wider-tip candidate overshot the CIRCLE envelope (22.002) and was tightened. The rejected drawing was a single lumpy three-lobed outline with a dot.
omissions: The small hole in the hub is dropped: at 48px a dot inside the r8 hub sits closer than 8 units. The hub is larger than in the reference because neighbouring blade roots need 8 units of clearance on its rim.
drawing_plan: Blade authored pointing up (roots (+-3,-7), tip (0,-20)), turned 120/240 degrees about (24,24) with rounded knots; hub = six r8 arcs through the six roots.
lucide_reference: Lucide 'fan': three swept blade lobes around a central hub circle.
